Horrible servicio no vayan es fraude me cobraron 3600 por reconstruir una transmisión supuestamente le iban a poner todas las partes nuevas pero tres veces me quedé tirado durante la garantía y se la tenia que regresar y ahora que ya no tiene garantía porque ya pasó el año me quedo tirado otra vez y muy prepotente me pide $1200 más O sea casi $5000 sin contar las gruas por un trabajo mal hecho y a medias. Si me lo hubiera hecho como me lo prometió desde un principio esa transmisión no me hubiera durado menos de 2 años a cada rato se la tenía que llevar otra vez porque nada más le arreglan unas cuantas partes y no les importa ayudarte simplemente es un vil robo     Horrible service—don't go there; it's a scam. They charged me $3,600 to rebuild a transmission, promising they would install all-new parts. Yet, I broke down three times while it was still under warranty and had to keep bringing it back to them. Now that the warranty has expired—since a year has passed—I've broken down again, and, acting with total arrogance, they are demanding another $1,200. That brings the total to nearly $5,000—not even counting towing fees—for a shoddy, half-finished job. If they had done the work properly, as they promised from the very beginning, that transmission wouldn't have failed in less than two years. I constantly had to take it back to them because they only ever fixed a few isolated parts; they have no interest in actually helping you. It is nothing short of outright robbery.
